AUTHOR: Frandsen
TITLE: Combining Deep Learning and Ecological Monitoring for BRUV Coral Reef Megafauna Assessment
REGION: Gita Nada Marine Protected Area, Lombok, Indonesia (Wallacea)
SPECIES: 28 focal species grouped into six Morphological Groups: Carangidae, Carcharhinidae, Cheilinus undulatus, Cheloniidae (sea turtles), Myliobatiformes, Sphyraenidae
DATA: Own footage: SORCE long-term BRUV monitoring, 244 deployments, 53 sites, 328 h (2023-2025); clips sampled at 2 fps, 7,781 frames incl. 1,597 null frames
V_EV: Section 2.4: 'To minimise environmental variability unrelated to habitat condition, deployments with visibility below 10 m or depths exceeding 15 m were excluded.'
D2: 80/10/10 train/val/test at BRUV-deployment level (5,770 / 975 / 1,036 frames; 244 deployments)
D_EV: Sec. 2.2.2: 'To prevent data leakage, where frames from the same video sequence appear in both training and testing, the split was performed at the BRUV deployment level'
R_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'A total of 244 BRUV surveys were undertaken, all within the Indonesian MPA of Gita Nada'
C_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'a sighting event was only retained if it persisted for a minimum duration of 1 s and was supported by detections across at least three distinct frames.'
E_EV: Section 2.3: 'The metrics generated by the pipeline (MaxN, T1st, and Tvisit) were directly compared to manual expert counts'; Table 3 MaxN accuracy 0.68 overall
ARCH: YOLOv12x fine-tuned from Community Fish Detector weights (1024 px, AdamW, 100 epochs) + rule-based temporal sighting tracker (5 s gap, min 1 s / 3 frames) + human-in-the-loop review
METR: Precision, recall, F1, mAP50, mAP50-95 per Morphological Group; tracker sighting recall/precision (50 test clips); MaxN, T1st, Tvisit accuracy vs expert (±1 s)
NOTE: Deployment-level split explicitly motivated by leakage avoidance (D4 = Y). Visibility is quantified only as an exclusion criterion (<10 m visibility excluded) for the ecological case study, not reported as a measured covariate for detection performance, so V1 = 기타 정량 with V6 = N gives V_ALL = P mechanically. Taxa include non-fish (sea turtles, rays) alongside fish; TAXA coded at family/order level. C5 coded as duplicate-count handling because the temporal clustering + MaxN logic explicitly addresses double-counting; tracker precision 0.76 on 50 expert-annotated test clips also quantifies false sightings, and a human-in-the-loop expert review corrects misidentifications in the case study (no FP rate reported for that step). Detection threshold 0.1 for evaluation and 0.20 for the tracker, chosen a priori; no threshold sweep. Myliobatiformes detection failed completely (F1 = 0). Tracker validation sample sizes per group are very small (1-29 events). Code/scripts promised 'where technically feasible' but no repository given, so CODE = N. Single MPA, no external test (R1 = N).
